_description: Shared WalletCore/WASM (packages/core) and RN-JS/@ton/core (packages/sdk) golden vector for a TON wallet V5R1 (W5) native transfer. The request is W5's signed_external: opcode 0x7369676e, wallet id, valid-until, seqno, then the out_list carrying one action_send_msg whose mode includes IGNORE_ACTION_PHASE_ERRORS (the W5 code requires it of every external action); the signature is appended after the request, not prefixed as in V4R2. expectedSigningHashHexSeqno0 covers the first send, where the external message also carries the StateInit.
